name: Pula (Hungary)
description: Three equal horizontal stripes of blue, white and green, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Pula (a crowned oval with a figure and a tree within a green wreath, with the year 1746) above the name PULA in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Pula arms with crown and wreath
